scripts.ensure-deps: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');if(!fs.existsSync('node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc')){console.log('Dependencies missing, running npm ci...');cp.execSync('npm ci',{stdio:'inherit'});}"
scripts.build:sidecar:node: npm run check:node-sidecar && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const binDir=path.join('src-tauri','bin');const source=path.join(binDir,'niko-gateway-node');if(!fs.existsSync(source)){throw new Error('Missing Node sidecar entry: '+source);}const target=path.join(binDir,'niko-gateway');fs.copyFileSync(source,target);try{fs.chmodSync(target,0o755);}catch{}if(process.platform==='win32'){const cmdSource=path.join(binDir,'niko-gateway-node.cmd');if(fs.existsSync(cmdSource)){fs.copyFileSync(cmdSource,path.join(binDir,'niko-gateway.cmd'));}}console.log('Node sidecar staged:',target);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run ensure-deps && tsc && vite build
